opening.argument: The video is centered on an ordinary birthday surprise: traveling to surprise a friend, providing a year-long supply of free burritos, and adding a car as a birthday gift. The title plainly identifies the occasion, “SURPRISING BEST FRIEND FOR HIS BIRTHDAY!!,” while the speaker explains, “So in honor of that I flew to my hometown to surprise one of my good friends Nic.” Its commercial segment is expressly disclosed as a Chipotle partnership, stating, “I've partnered with Chipotle which is pretty nuts, they gave me my own burrito.” The request to order that burrito online is ordinary product promotion, not a request for investment funds, credentials, or financial participation. The shoutout and Snapchat invitation are social-engagement prompts consistent with the surrounding entertainment, not evidence of deceptive solicitation.
